## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.0

- Adds connected vertical spines and horizontal branch connectors to nested ordered, unordered, and task lists.
- Supports independently toggleable Live Preview, Source mode, and Reading mode rendering.
- Uses Obsidian's searchable setting-definition API for every plugin setting.
- Adds Style Settings controls for guide color, opacity, thickness, connector geometry, line pattern, and unordered-list bullet visibility.
- Adds precise editable numeric fields synchronized with every Style Settings slider.
- Includes deterministic validation and GitHub artifact attestations for all three release assets.
